focus_areas: Stitching continuity and elevation (shadows under threads)
Clarity and legibility of the blue stamped logo
Edge sharpness between ball and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the blue stamped logo. In AI-generated images, such markings often degrade into nonsensical shapes or 'alien' script. Verify if the characters are coherent. Also, inspect the intersection of the red stitching with the white leather; look for any 'bleeding' of red pixels into the white area or lack of proper shadowing under the raised threads, which would indicate a flat, painted-on appearance rather than physical stitching.
image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a white baseball. The ball features the characteristic red double-stitching in a figure-eight pattern. There is a distinct blue ink stamp or logo on the front surface containing stylized characters/numbers. The background is blurred (bokeh), suggesting a shallow depth of field, with hints of red and white colors, possibly indicating a stadium or sports setting.

expert_testimonies.reason: To confirm the object is taxonomically a baseball and not a similar spherical object (e.g., cricket ball, softball) based on stitch density and leather texture.
To analyze the blue stamped mark for gibberish or malformed characters, as AI often struggles with rendering coherent text/logos on curved surfaces.
To verify the structural integrity of the red stitching, ensuring threads do not melt into the leather or break continuity, which is a common AI artifact.
To assess overall sharpness, noise levels, and lighting consistency, acting as a general quality gate.
